items.title: AWS Capacity Largely Sold Out Through 2027, With On Demand Headroom Reserved
items.blurb: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy says AWS’s large committed cloud capacity is largely sold out through 2027, with part of 2028 already allocated, while the company continues to reserve headroom for On Demand, EC2 and Bedrock.

items.title: File Mover Express: AWS Releases Open-Source Tool for S3 File Transfers
items.blurb: AWS has recently released File Mover Express, an open-source application under the Apache 2.0 license for transferring large files between local systems and Amazon S3.

items.title: Cloudflare’s Post-Quantum GeoKey Manager Enters Closed Beta Without Attribute-Based Encryption
items.blurb: Cloudflare has moved a post-quantum rebuild of GeoKey Manager into closed beta, guarding geo-fenced keys with hybrid ML-KEM-768 and X25519 instead of the attribute-based encryption used since 2022.

items.title: Free TLS for internal services on AWS
Amazon RDS for Oracle no longer requires automatic minor version upgrades for JVM, Spatial, Locator, and OLAP options
items.blurb: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for Oracle now lets you turn off automatic minor version upgrades on new and existing DB instances that use the JVM, Spatial, Locator, or OLAP option.

items.title: AWS WAF announces automatic SDK integration for Amazon CloudFront distributions
items.blurb: AWS WAF announces automatic SDK integration for Amazon CloudFront distributions. When you enable it, CloudFront adds the script tag for the AWS WAF JavaScript SDK to the HTML it serves, with no change to your application code, build…

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer now supports versioning and aliasing for flows
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer now supports versioning and aliasing for flows and flow modules, simplifying how you build, test, and deploy customer experience flows while minimizing impact to live end-customer traffic.

items.title: Managed Prometheus collectors now support Amazon MSK consumer-group metrics
items.blurb: Managed Prometheus collectors now support Amazon MSK consumer-group metrics for Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus and Amazon CloudWatch .

items.title: AWS Glue Data Catalog now supports Apache Iceberg table optimization in the US West (N. California) Region
items.blurb: AWS Glue Data Catalog now supports automatic table optimization for Apache Iceberg tables in the US West (N. California) Region. Apache Iceberg is an open table format that delivers fast query performance over large tables in data lakes.

items.title: Amazon SageMaker AI inference now supports GPU partitioning for real-time endpoints
items.blurb: Amazon SageMaker AI inference now supports GPU partitioning, enabling you to run several models on a single GPU instead of dedicating a whole accelerator to each one.
